{{Top}}
A '''training officer''' was an individual responsible for training recruits in combat tactics and weapons skills. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Gar Berra|Gar "Crazy Man" Berra]] was the head training officer for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Oracle Base]] in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]].
